parts.name: culms_bamboo
sources: About 30 branches on a culm, from nearly each node; the low branches are horizontal and spiny, a thicket of 2 to 3 m; the high ones grow up (PROSEA; Kew GrassBase). The model has branches on the top 60 % of a culm.
The radius of the clump at its base: an estimate.
10 to 40 culms in a clump (PROSEA); 20 is the middle.
The culms are 15 to 25 m tall (PROSEA, Bambusa blumeana).
The internodes are 25 to 60 cm long (PROSEA).
The leaves are 15 to 20 by 1.5 to 2 cm (PROSEA); the sprays of leaves at the ends of the branches are cards of 0.45 by 0.18 m (an estimate).
The culms are 5 to 10 cm across, to 20 cm, with a wall of 0.5 to 3 cm (PROSEA).
